assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, Illumina NovaSeq X Plus PE150, C2C12 myotubes (S4.10.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 24 h electrical pulse stimulation (EPS, in vitro exercise-mimicking contraction; S2.1.p2, S4.9.p1) on gene expression in control C2C12 myotubes, and its dependence on Maff (EPS response in Maff KO myotubes; genotype x EPS interaction; S2.4.p1)
sample_inclusion: All 12 GEO samples: Ctrl basal, Ctrl EPS, KO basal, KO EPS, n = 3 each (GEO characteristics). RNA harvested at day 7 of differentiation; EPS applied from day 6 for 24 h (S4.2.p2, S4.7.p1, S4.9.p1)
planned_contrasts: EPS vs basal in Ctrl myotubes (exercise effect; S2.4.p1 qRT-PCR only, no RNA-seq DEG count reported)
EPS vs basal in Maff KO myotubes (S2.4.p1 qRT-PCR only)
genotype x EPS interaction (attenuated EPS response in KO; S2.4.p1)
Maff KO vs Ctrl at day 7, basal (S2.3.p2: RNA-seq 588 down / 687 up DEGs, adjusted P < 0.001, n = 3/group, FIG6)
repeated_measure_unit: none; independent culture wells, no pairing reported
normalization: RaNA-seq framework, GRCm38; TPM deposited (S4.10.p1, GEO data_processing)
paper_method: DESeq2 (S4.10.p1); paper does not state the design formula or which samples entered the KO vs Ctrl test

paper_results.KO_vs_Ctrl_RNAseq: 588 down, 687 up at adjusted P < 0.001; down includes muscle contraction/sarcomere genes; qRT-PCR down: Tnnc1, Xirp1, Xirp2, Myl1, Mybpc2, Nrap (S2.3.p2, FIG6)
paper_results.EPS_in_Ctrl_qPCR: EPS up in Ctrl: Myh2, Myh7, Abra, Acta1, Actc1, Atp2a2, Mettl21c; Maff and Mafa induced (FIG1 D); Myh1 and Egr1 unchanged (S2.4.p1)
paper_results.EPS_in_KO_qPCR: EPS responses not significant / blunted in KO; Myh4 reduced by EPS in KO only (S2.4.p1)
